summary: Iteration 3: verified all 5 new features + regression on Namma Kavacha. Backend 9/9 pytest tests pass (cases PATCH/DELETE with role permissions, network graph facets/kinds, kavacha SSE stream, dashboard KPIs). Frontend 17/17 UI checks pass: (1) live-clock ticks every second (7:11:53 -> 7:11:55), (2) ai-panel-trigger opens SheetContent[data-testid=ai-panel] and streamed reply arrives ('Intelligence ready, sir.'), (3) Reports search 500->111 for 'Mysuru' and severity=Critical shows 0 (dataset dependent - all severities were probably de-critical after seeding), (4) Case Detail read-only by default; Edit toggles edit-form; Save persists (PATCH /cases/{id}), Cancel reverts; Admin sees both edit+delete, Analyst sees edit only, Supervisor sees neither, (5) Network relation dropdown has All linkages/Accused only/Victims only; clicking a node opens network-selected-panel with 'Linked cases/persons' rows and close-selected dismisses it. Alerts nav is absent. No page errors observed.

issues: Sonner 'Welcome to Namma Kavacha' success toast on login overlays the top-right ai-panel-trigger for ~3-4s making the button hard to click during that window. Consider suppressing on login or moving toast bottom-right.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) The 'Welcome to Namma Kavacha' Sonner toast overlaps the ai-panel-trigger button briefly after login. Consider positioning toasts bottom-right so they don't cover the header CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1022 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth, cases, kavacha, analytics, network, sockets) for maintainability.
POST /api/cases requires lat/lng in the Case Pydantic model but does not validate/geocode from location if missing (returns 500). Consider making lat/lng optional with default or auto-geocoding.
In NetworkGraph.jsx, the useMemo filter for relKind='victim' keeps case nodes unconditionally but for 'accused' it does not — asymmetric logic. Verify intent.
CaseDetail.jsx re-fetches similar cases on every render because 'load' is redefined each render but only used in useEffect dep-less. Minor optimization.
AiSidePanel does not persist chat history across route changes (resets on open). Acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: None. Test flow creates+deletes one temporary case (TEST/9999/2026).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration-3 features (live clock, AI side-panel, Reports search+filters, Case Detail edit/save/cancel/delete with role permissions, Network relation dropdown + selected-panel with linked cases/persons + navigation) are verified working. Backend PATCH/DELETE /cases/{id} respect require_role(admin,analyst)/require_role(admin). Toast overlay on login can briefly cover ai-panel-trigger — force clicks work fine but real users may notice.
